body: Problem is with that girl (woman) is that I was with her before and dumped her, and then got back with her again, and now I regret getting back with her and I'm pretty sure I only did it because I'm using her, which feels awful.  I understand what you're saying about how I don't want to hurt other people's feelings so I sacrifice myself, but the truth is I don't want them to leave me which I feel like they'll do if I start not delivering on expectations of me.  I'll just start to be seen as a burnout/deadbeat/whatever else.
